summary: Restore preset and circuit-fence request for optimizer experiment causing latency asymmetry
description:
Issue summary:
Customer applied a tenant-scoped optimizer profile (aggressive batching + KV-prefetch + mixed quant) to a dedicated pool yesterday evening. Since the change, DataWeave Labs reports uneven tail latency and ~15% error increase on multi-turn chat routes. They request: 1) an immediate safe recovery plan that restores known-good defaults for the tenant, and 2) a short 'circuit-fence' routing policy to keep the tenant on conservative serving paths while we validate optimizer flags.

Impact:
- Customer-facing chat agents experiencing sporadic 5xx and increased 95p/99p latency during business hours.
- Traffic volume: ~120 reqs/s sustained, peak 240 reqs/s.

Desired outcome:
- Return tenant to stable performance with minimal disruption to traffic.
- Provide stepwise commands to apply rollback preset and a routing fence (non-destructive, reversible).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Tenant config: applied optimizer profile 'exp-mixed-quant-prefetch-v5' at 2026-03-09T20:10Z
2) Traffic pattern: multi-turn chat with avg context length 600 tokens, 30% of requests use streaming responses
3) Observe metrics: 95p token latency increases and occasional 502/503 on serving-runtime workers
logs:
Excerpt from serving-runtime logs (redacted):
[2026-03-10T02:14:21Z] tenant=dataweave pool=dedicated-12 worker=ii-23 WARN KV_PREFETCH: evict-mismatch detected for model rw-instruct-v2-small
[2026-03-10T02:14:22Z] tenant=dataweave pool=dedicated-12 worker=ii-23 ERROR STREAM_DISCONNECT: downstream reset during chunked write
[2026-03-10T02:14:35Z] tenant=dataweave pool=dedicated-12 worker=ii-45 WARN BATCH_QUEUE: batch-size-target dropped below min due to inflight quant-locks
investigation_notes: Telemetry shows spike in tail latency aligned with optimizer toggle window (20:10Z). No infrastructure scale events in cloud provider metrics.
Hypothesis A: aggressive KV-prefetch collided with mixed-quant memory layout causing transient memcpy stalls on some workers.
Hypothesis B: asynchronous batching with streaming enabled produced backpressure that exposed a race in recent kernel path for rw-instruct-v2-small.
Checked: model pinning is correct, no cross-tenant model swaps observed. Verified dedicated pool has expected GPU headroom at time of incidents.
comments: Maya Chen (Support) 2026-03-10T09:15Z: Customer reports 95p latency up ~60ms and ~8% error rate increase after profile change. Requested safe rollback and routing fence. Attaching telemetry dashboard link: https://console.redwood/dashboards/tenants/dataweave/opt-experiment

Derek Patel (SRE) 2026-03-10T10:02Z: I see the same tail spikes on ingestion credit. Starting runbook: recommend applying tenant preset 'stable-serving-v2' and enabling routing.policy=circuit_fence:conservative. Will hand-hold steps.
DataWeave Support Lead (Customer) 2026-03-10T10:18Z: Please minimize downtime — prefer live-config swap without full restart. Happy to shift small % of traffic for canary before full swap.

Derek Patel (SRE) 2026-03-10T10:45Z: Agreed. Plan: 1) create snapshot of current tenant optimizer flags 2) apply 'stable-serving-v2' to 10% traffic for 10 minutes 3) ramp to 100% if metrics stable. Will also set routing fence that pins to conservative batching/disable-prefetch.
proposed_workaround:
Immediate non-destructive steps (commands/console fields):
1) Snapshot current tenant optimizer config: POST /admin/tenants/dataweave/snapshot?tag=pre-rollback-2026-03-10
2) Create a temporary preset 'stable-serving-v2' with fields: batching.max_inflight=8, batching.async=false, kv_prefetch.enabled=false, quant.profile=fp16-reliable
3) Apply preset to 10% via traffic-split: PATCH /admin/tenants/dataweave/traffic-split {"rules": [{"percent":10, "preset":"stable-serving-v2"}]}
4) Verify for 10 minutes: 95p latency, error-rate, and worker OOMs. If green, set percent to 100% and remove experimental preset.
5) Enable routing fence to keep future optimizer changes on conservative path: PUT /admin/tenants/dataweave/routing {"policy":"circuit_fence:conservative", "reason":"post-experiment-stability"}
Notes: All API calls require admin token. Console UI path: Tenant > Config > Presets > Create/Apply > Traffic Split.
resolution: Pending - rollback staged. Support to coordinate with customer for canary ramping and metrics verification. Will update when traffic returned to stable preset or if escalation needed.
